user.title: Connect an EcoPulse gateway
user.description: Enter the gateway's address on your network and the Home Assistant integration token. You create the token in the EcoPulse web app, on the gateway's Home Assistant settings; it is shown only once.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the gateway on your LAN.
data_description.port: Port of the gateway's local web server (8080 unless changed).
data_description.token: Starts with ecp_ha_. This is not the gateway's web password.

zeroconf_confirm.title: EcoPulse gateway found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found gateway {id} at {host}. Enter its Home Assistant integration token from the EcoPulse web app.

data_description.token: Starts with ecp_ha_. This is not the gateway's web password.

reauth_confirm.title: Token for {name} no longer valid
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway rejected the integration token, usually because it was rotated in the EcoPulse web app. Enter the new token.

data_description.token: Starts with ecp_ha_. This is not the gateway's web password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the gateway. Check the host and port and that the gateway's local web server is enabled.
error.invalid_auth: The gateway rejected the token. Copy it again from the EcoPulse web app or rotate it there.
error.invalid_token_format: This is not an integration token; it must start with ecp_ha_.
error.not_enabled: Home Assistant is not enabled for this gateway, or its firmware is too old. Enable it in the EcoPulse web app and wait for the configuration to reach the gateway.
error.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts from this address. Wait a few minutes and try again.

abort.invalid_discovery_info: The discovered gateway did not announce its id.
abort.unsupported_api_version: This gateway does not offer a Home Assistant API version this integration supports. Update the integration.
abort.wrong_gateway: This token belongs to a different gateway.
